lines.speaker: Doflamingo
lines.text: Fuffuffuffu! Another little insect crawls straight into my web!

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: Doflamingo! Your reign over this palace ends right now.

lines.speaker: Doflamingo
lines.text: Justice? Evil? Those terms mean nothing! The only truth in this world is power!

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: Then feel the weight of everyone you crushed underneath your heel!

lines.speaker: Doflamingo
lines.text: Fuffuffuffu! Dance upon my strings until you break, you pathetic worm!
